findings.reason: The evidence shows the alarm and maintenance window overlap, but does not prove the maintenance caused the signal loss.
ALR-0001 explicitly states the time window and the drop in traffic and availability for the two sites.
ALM-000037 confirms a critical LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SUD-02-B raised at the specified time.
MW-0001's window (22:12-03:14) overlaps the alarm time (22:39) on the same node.
ALM-000038 and ALM-000039 both confirm critical SITE_DOWN alarms on the respective sites at 22:40.
T3 output explicitly states no changes occurred on the specified nodes and parents within the time window.
